name: Guangzhou, Shenzhen & Hong Kong
goal: Canton Fair in Guangzhou, a day in Shenzhen, then home through Hong Kong. 15–17 Oct 2026, China time.

blocks.title: Breakfast near the hotel
blocks.note: Eat properly: the halls are huge and lunch queues are long.

blocks.title: Metro to Pazhou
blocks.note: Line 8 or Line 11 to Pazhou station. Check your hall and gate before choosing the exit.

blocks.title: Badge and entry, Canton Fair
blocks.note: Phase 1, 15–19 Oct: electronics, machinery, manufacturing. Badge, passport, business cards.

blocks.title: Halls: shortlist suppliers
blocks.note: Photograph each booth card next to the product so you can match them later.

blocks.title: Lunch inside the complex
blocks.note: Go early or late; 12:00 sharp is the worst queue.

blocks.title: Meetings and second pass
blocks.note: Prices, MOQ, lead times. Ask for WeChat contacts.

blocks.title: Supplier notes while fresh
blocks.note: One line per supplier: product, price, MOQ, gut feeling.

blocks.title: Dinner: roast goose
blocks.note: Cantonese roast meats near the hotel.

blocks.title: Sleep
blocks.note: Big walking day tomorrow too.

blocks.title: Breakfast and check out
blocks.note: Leave nothing in the room; the fair catalogues are heavy.

blocks.title: Metro to Guangzhou South
blocks.note: Line 2 or 7. Real-name ticket: passport or Home Return Permit at the gate.

blocks.title: High-speed rail: Guangzhou South → Shenzhen North
blocks.note: About 30–35 minutes. Be at the gate 20 minutes early.

blocks.title: Metro to Futian, drop bags at the hotel
blocks.note: Line 4 to Futian. Ask the front desk to hold your bags.

blocks.title: Huaqiangbei electronics market
blocks.note: Compare with what you saw at the fair. SEG Plaza and the side buildings.

blocks.title: Lunch near Huaqiangbei
blocks.note: Chaoshan rice noodles or a quick dim sum place.

blocks.title: OCT Loft creative park
blocks.note: Galleries, cafés and design shops in old factory buildings.

blocks.title: Shenzhen Museum or a mall instead
blocks.note: Indoors near Civic Center if it rains.

blocks.title: Shenzhen Bay Park at sunset
blocks.note: Walk the bay towards Talent Park; Hong Kong is across the water.

blocks.title: Dinner: Chaoshan beef hotpot
blocks.note: Cuts arrive by name; each one takes only seconds in the pot.

blocks.title: Back to the hotel
blocks.note: Taxi or DiDi to Futian.

blocks.title: Book tomorrow's train and pack
blocks.note: Futian → Hong Kong West Kowloon around 09:30, second class. Passport or Home Return Permit ready.

blocks.title: Light breakfast
blocks.note: Save room for yum cha in Hong Kong.

blocks.title: Check out, walk to Futian Station
blocks.note: The station is underground, below Shennan Avenue.

blocks.title: Through security at Futian
blocks.note: Allow 45 minutes on weekends: security and real-name checks.

blocks.title: High-speed rail: Futian → West Kowloon
blocks.note: About 14 minutes.

blocks.title: Co-located immigration at West Kowloon
blocks.note: Mainland exit and Hong Kong entry are both inside the station.

blocks.title: Cross at Futian Checkpoint instead
blocks.note: Walk across to Lok Ma Chau, then the MTR East Rail line into town.
blocks.branch: If the train is sold out

blocks.title: Yum cha
blocks.note: Har gow, siu mai, char siu bao. Welcome back.

blocks.title: West Kowloon harbourfront and M+
blocks.note: Harbour views from the promenade, then the museum if you have energy left.

blocks.title: Follow up with suppliers
blocks.note: Thank-you messages to the best three, with the questions you didn't get to ask.

blocks.title: Debrief the trip
blocks.note: What worked at the fair, which supplier to chase first, the moment you'll remember.
